summary: Implemented print_json in the repository, but it is unverified: I did not run any tests or code, as instructed. Changes: (1) new rich/json.py with a JSON renderable (parses with json.loads, re-serializes with json.dumps, optional JSONHighlighter via RegexHighlighter) and JSON.from_data; (2) Console.print_json in rich/console.py, which accepts a JSON string or data=..., raises TypeError for non-string json, and prints with soft_wrap=True; (3) module-level print_json in rich/__init__.py forwarding to the global console, with Union imported and print_json added to __all__. Nothing was committed. Open choices to review: highlighter regexes and keyword set were written from memory of Rich's design rather than a repo spec; from_data uses cls.__new__ to bypass the constructor; no tests or docs were added.
